> **This project is archived and no longer developed.**

> The official dsh web UI now"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" supports this plugin's functionality natively: **Settings → Work details** (`Compact` / `Detailed` "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"/ `Expanded`) folds a turn's process into a compact reading line, and it has shipped since dsh **0.1"},{"id":"p4s4","text":".7-alpha.1**. There is no longer any reason to install this plugin.
>

[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p5s1","text":">
> The repository is read-only from here on: no further releases, issues, or pull requests."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A plugin for the dsh web GUI that adds a **focus chat** tab — a condensed, Claude Code–style way to "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"read a conversation."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Off — the normal chat view | On — the focus chat view |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Settings |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Instead of watching every step live, one assistant turn collapses into a single summary line:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> Thought for 36s, edited 8 files, read 17 files, listed 18 directories, ran 2 shell commands, loade"},{"id":"p11s2","text":", edited 8 files, read 17 files, listed 18 directories, ran 2 shell commands, loaded 3 context items"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A whole turn can fold further into one `Worked for Xm Ys` line — expanding it draws the full detail "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"(tool cards, thinking, context, produced files, copy/fork) exactly like the chat rows; mid-turn inte"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"rjections split the fold into per-stretch lines, and a stopped turn reads `Stopped after X`. **After"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" a refresh the whole conversation shows up folded**: every turn beyond the ~50-message window render"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"s from a Host-side index as "user message + worked-for line + the assistant's actual closing reply","},{"id":"p12s6","text":" and its process detail loads only when that fold expands. Very long histories page the fold stack v"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ia "Load earlier turns"; a missing index silently degrades to the in-window folds."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Switch to it whenever you want the "what happened?" view, and flip back for the full transcript."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install (deprecated)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> The plugin is archived; prefer the built-in **Work details** setting described in the warning abov"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e. The steps below are kept only for existing installs."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then open the Focus chat tab in any conversation."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Notes:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `dsh plugin` behaves like adding a dependency to your web profile. A bundle plugin is loaded once "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"its full package name appears in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list (adds automatically on rec"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ent dsh builds; add it manually if your build does not); the bundle patch applies on the next boot.
"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"- With the repo source-launched CLI, run the args through the bin directly (`node --import tsx/esm a"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"pps/cli/src/bin.ts ...`)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Why a separate tab, and not a patch into the chat view?"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Short answer: the chat view's internals aren't open to third-party plugins — by design — and this pl"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ugin deliberately never touches dsh's own source. Concretely:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Keyed slots are owned, not shared.** The chat's rows render through slots like `conversation.cha"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"t.node`, `tool.call.toolview`, and `conversation.chat.turnTail`. Those slots are declared by the cha"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"t entries themselves, and the slot system rejects a second declaration at load time — the conflict *"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"is* the design speaking. A plugin cannot insert its own rows into the chat transcript, and cannot ev"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"en *declare* the chat's own slots.
- **Plugins can't reuse the chat's renderer code.** Importing val"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ues from another plugin package across the bundle boundary is forbidden (the bundle purity gate), so"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" there's no way to borrow the chat's components — every row has to be drawn from the shared primitiv"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"es and the public snapshot.
- **The only legal insertion point is the `conversation.view` list slot*"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"* — the whole message surface. That's why the plugin ships its own complete view instead of changing"},{"id":"p22s10","text":" how the chat view displays."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"If you want the chat view itself to behave differently, that's an in-repo change to the chat package"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" — exactly what this plugin avoids."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## What's missing"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Focus chat is a faithful reading surface, not a second chat view:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Inspect focuses the trajectory view.** A tool row's Inspect action opens the official trajectory"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" view on that call (`openView('trajectory', callId)`) — the 0.1.5 replacement for the removed detail"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s panel. Focus cannot render third-party keyed tool views (see the next bullet).
- **Third-party too"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"l-card extensions don't render here.** Cards that other plugins add to the chat view won't appear in"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" the focus view; the built-in card renderers are used instead.
- **Folding is per consecutive tool-r"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"un.** Any visible content between two runs (a reply, a command, your interjection) keeps them separa"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"te.
- **Inline file links need the optional file-mentions service** — the same off switch the chat v"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"iew uses.
- **Remote fold lines lack a few window-only readings.** The turn navigator rail lists win"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"dow turns only; remote turns render no produced-file list (the ui-deliverables turn data), no inline"},{"id":"p26s10","text":" file mentions, and their closing reply cannot fork (branching stays available on window turns). Per"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"-message feedback (like/dislike) is unaffected."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"> This build targets the dsh v0.1.6-alpha.1 client surface, and every `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime depen"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"dency installs from the npm registry (see `package.json`). The `/client` entries those packages ship"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" are `window.__ModuleLoader__` browser closures, and the dsh test runtime is built against the sourc"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"e tree, so `yarn test` resolves the `@deepseek-ai` client surface from the dsh mainline source check"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"out at the same 0.1.6-alpha.1 line: `vitest.config.ts` derives its aliases from that checkout's own "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"tsconfig path map (the `MAINLINE` constant in the config) — keep the checkout on the 0.1.6-alpha.1 r"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"elease and everything else stays npm-installed."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- `yarn run build` — builds the browser bundle and the Node half.
- `src/client/model/` — the pure l"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ogic (folding, merging, row models, the remote turn-slice projection); `src/client/view/FocusView.ts"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"x` — the view; `src/host/` — the host half's turn index and RPC channel; `src/protocol.ts` — the wir"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"e contract shared by both halves.
- `yarn test` — behavior tests; `yarn run typecheck` — type gate.
